newsitem.title: USA: Sun Television names Carter Pate chairman. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sun Television names Carter Pate chairman. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects earlier story by deleting references to James Copitzky.)
Sun Television and Appliances Inc said Friday its board had named Carter Pate as chairman, a post that had been vacant since last June.

It said Pate's appointment followed the board's decision to retain Business Turnaround Services (BTS), a retail consulting division of Price Waterhouse Inc. Pate, a partner of Price Waterhouse, was a regional managing partner of BTS, Sun Television said.
The decision to retain BTS was made "in response to the continuing difficulties facing the consumer electronics retailing industry," the company said.
On January 9 Sun Television announced plans to close nine stores in New York State and in Dayton and Springfield, Ohio.
The closures, set for March 1, would lead to a charge in the fourth quarter, it said. The stores generated 15 percent of its consolidated sales, it said.
Sun Television reported a loss of $0.23 a share for the third quarter ended November 30, against a profit of $0.08 a year earlier.
